name: 窄卡片＋圖片卡片並排，右下角疊文字面板
desc: 一窄一寬兩張等高卡片並排，窄卡片放置中的短標題，寬卡片是一張填滿卡片的圖片；寬卡片右下角疊一塊文字面板，放標題、說明文字與按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。兩張等高的卡片左右並排，對齊頁面內容寬度，兩張卡片之間留明顯較寬的間隔：左側是窄卡片，約佔三成寬度，呈直式；右側是寬卡片，約佔其餘的寬度，呈橫式。左卡片的內容水平與垂直都置中：標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放一個小圖示，沒有時省略。右卡片是一張填滿整張卡片的橫式圖片。右卡片的右下角疊著一塊文字面板，底色和頁面底色相同，貼齊右卡片的右緣與下緣，寬約右卡片的一半、高約右卡片的下半部；面板在圖片前面，蓋住圖片右下的一部分。面板內靠左放標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字，最下方靠右可放按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，由上而下是左卡片、右卡片、文字面板，兩張卡片都對齊頁面內容寬度。左卡片維持直式、內容置中；右卡片改為一張橫式圖片。文字面板不再疊在圖片上，取消重疊，改為放在圖片下方的一段靠左文字，按鈕橫跨整欄。

en.name: Narrow card and image card side by side + text panel overlapping the bottom-right corner
en.desc: A narrow and a wide card of equal height sit side by side; the narrow card holds a short centered title and the wide card is an image filling the card; a text panel with a title, description and button overlaps the bottom-right corner of the wide card.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Two cards of equal height sit side by side, aligned to the page content width, with a noticeably wide gap between the two cards: on the left is a narrow portrait card taking about thirty percent of the width; on the right is a wide landscape card taking the remaining width. The content of the left card is centered both horizontally and vertically: a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a small icon below; omit them when there is no content. The right card is a single landscape image filling the entire card. A text panel overlaps the bottom-right corner of the right card; its background matches the page background, it is flush with the right edge and bottom edge of the right card, about half the width of the right card and about its lower half in height. The panel is in front of the image and covers the lower-right part of it. Inside the panel, a title (may wrap to multiple lines) is aligned left, optionally with a label above, a description below and a button aligned right at the very bottom; omit them when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically, from top to bottom: the left card, the right card, then the text panel; both cards are aligned to the page content width. The left card stays portrait with its content centered; the right card becomes a single landscape image. The text panel no longer overlaps the image; the overlap is removed and it becomes a left-aligned block of text below the image, with the button spanning the full column.
